name: ax-extract-workflow
description: Reconstruct the workflow behind a past artifact - "what made X work" / "extract workflow from <date|sha>" / "how did we ship Y". Uses ax to find the relevant sessions and narrate the ordered skill arcs that produced the result. Triggers on "what made X work", "how did we build Y", "extract workflow from <date>", "extract workflow from <sha>", "what was the workflow around <topic>", "show me how I shipped <feature>", "reconstruct the recipe for <artifact>". Do NOT fire on generic "show recent act
author: Necmttn
summary_zh: 从历史会话中还原某个成果的完整产出流程，适合复盘功能上线、提炼成功经验或追溯特定版本的实现路径。
